In the blood stain row, A is +++, B is +, C is +++, and the enzyme-free control is +; in the oil stain row, A is +, B is +++, C is +++, and the enzyme-free control is +. Then reason: The main component of silk fabric is protein, and laundry detergent containing protease will decompose protein fibers, so it is not suitable for washing silk. Blood stains mainly contain protein; if the removal effect of a certain laundry detergent on blood stains is clearly better than that of the enzyme-free control, it indicates that it may contain protease. In the table, enzyme-added laundry detergents A and C are both +++ for blood stains, clearly better than the control's +; enzyme-added laundry detergent B is only + for blood stains, the same as the control. Therefore, those not suitable for washing silk fabrics are enzyme-added laundry detergent A and enzyme-added laundry detergent C.
